text.description_html:
Schlage FB50BEL, Georgian Knob and Deadbolt Set

The Keyed Entry Georgian Knob and Deadbolt Set will fit most predrilled doors. It is adjustable to fit doors that are 1-3/8 inches up to 1-3/4 inches thick with either 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. The B-Series Deadbolt with Keyed Georgian Knob comes packaged as a set with a keyed entry function door knob and a single cylinder deadbolt. Now, changing the locks on your front door has never been easier!

Combo Set Function: The knob is unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside always unlocked. The deadbolt thrown or retracted with a key from the outside and by turn unit on the inside. Bolt automatically deadlocks when fully thrown.

Features of the B-Series Deadbolt Combo Pack with Georgian Knob:

  • Interior Deadbolt Thumb Turn Meets ADA Requirements
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.2 Grade 3 Security
  • 1" deadbolt throw.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Fits most pre-drilled doors.
  • 5-pin tumbler C keyway.
  • Easy to install.
  • Reversible handing.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty.
  • Lifetime Mechanical Warranty.

Features for the B-Series Deadbolt Combo Pack with Georgian Knob:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/16"
  • Knob Projection: 2-5/16"
  • Deadbolt Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Round Corner Full Lip Strike and 1-1/8" x 2-3/4" Deadbolt Strike

Both locks (door knob lock and deadbolt lock) are keyed alike (use the same key). If ordering more than 1 lock set you can have each set Keyed Different or Keyed Alike.
